purpose: This table is the carrier reference lookup for the nycflights13-derived warehouse: one row per airline carrier code with its full legal name, feeding joins from flight-level fact tables that record only the two-letter carrier code.
usage: Join downstream flight tables to this table on carrier_code to resolve a human-readable carrier_name; both columns are required and non-null so no null-handling logic is needed by consumers.
limitations: The table is a small static reference set (16 rows, no duplicates, no nulls) limited to carriers that flew from New York City airports in 2013 per the source package's scope; it does not cover carriers added or renamed after that snapshot, and all pipeline-capture columns (raw id, extraction timestamp, meta) were dropped as non-business artifacts.
